description: Test-only world mutation. When explicitly enabled with TPF3MP_INDUSTRY_FIXTURE=1 and TPF3MP_INDUSTRY_FIXTURE_UPDATE, appends one previously missing valid cargo demand to the lowest-ID town at that exact simulation update. Installs no production behavior and is not ordinary-play acceptance.
